description: The Japanese catalog (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ja.ts) was written without a fluent reviewer. Before a Japanese release, a fluent reader reviews the consent and privacy strings (app.consent*, settings.consent*, settings.privacy*, settings.voiceToService, settings.voiceSwitch, people.forgetBody) for accuracy and tone, then skims the rest against the glossary in docs/i18n.md. Fix strings in ja.ts; pnpm check keeps the catalog complete.
title: Fluent review of Japanese consent and privacy wording
